headline: Fronts Remain Volatile as Ownership Ledger Turns
war_summary: The latest returns show a marked cooling from the previous edition’s fiercest exchanges, though several contested fronts remain on watch. Callahan’s Passage still leads the active ledger with 25 events in 24 hours, including two in the latest two-hour window, but that is well below its earlier pace; nine Warden bases and one Colonial base currently stand. Weathered Expanse also logged 25 events, four recently, while retaining a seven-Colonial, two-Warden split. Nevish Line recorded 20 daily events but none in the latest two hours, with seven Warden bases against one Colonial. Stlican Shelf saw 14 events, two recent, and remains divided six Colonial to three Warden. Stonecradle posted 13 events, two recent, with seven Colonial, two Warden, and no neutral bases. Linn Mercy has quieted to five daily events, though two arrived in the latest two-hour window; its eleven bases are all Colonial. Fisherman’s Row recorded nine events but has gone still since the prior edition. Elsewhere, ownership is largely settled and recent strategic-base activity is absent.
